findings.defect: The established rendering of 샤오 is lost: the accepted baseline uses Xiao, while the assembled text uses Shao throughout the references to Shao Shen.
findings.rationale: The source name is 샤오, and the accepted baseline establishes Xiao as the English rendering. This is a continuity and proper-name regression.

findings.current: but none posed any real threat.
findings.defect: “No real threat” weakens the source’s absolute statement that the monsters posed no threat whatsoever.
findings.rationale: 아무런 위협도 되지 못했다 states that they were not a threat at all, not merely that they were not a serious threat.
findings.replacement: but they posed no threat whatsoever.

findings.defect: The body’s rolling motion is lost.
findings.rationale: 굴러떨어지고 specifically depicts the officer’s body rolling down or out of the armored vehicle, rather than merely toppling.
findings.replacement: was rolling out of the armored vehicle.

findings.defect: The child’s name is presented as an unsupported romanization without an established ledger rendering or first-use footnote.
findings.rationale: 진진 is not present in the established name ledger. Under the chapter rules, an unlisted proper name should receive a first-use note unless an established English form is available.

summary: The assembled chapter is largely faithful, but it contains a few minor fidelity and terminology defects.
